name: Past Paper
statement: ABCD is a convex quadrilateral with area 1 square unit. AB is produced to $B^{\prime}$ with $BB^{\prime} = AB$; BC is produced to $C^{\prime}$ with $CC^{\prime} = BC$; CD is produced to $D^{\prime}$ with $DD^{\prime} = CD$; DA is produced to $A^{\prime}$ with $AA^{\prime} = DA$. Find the area of the quadrilateral $A^{\prime}B^{\prime}C^{\prime}D^{\prime}$.
